raw_text: BSF INTEL ALERT — Telegram Channel (Restricted). SITREP: Bangladesh border sectors Petrapole, Hili, and Agartala report increased civilian movement toward crossing points. Local informants indicate families from Rajshahi and Rangpur divisions are moving south toward the Indian border. No organized mass crossing observed yet but pattern is consistent with pre-displacement behavior. BSF has activated additional observation posts and mobile patrols in West Bengal and Tripura sectors. Coordination with Bangladesh Border Guard (BGB) ongoing. Next update at 2000 hrs IST.
